snippet.description:
Preparing for UPSC CSE? Here’s one important piece of advice from AIR 207 Sugandha Gupta for UPSC beginners.

You don’t need multiple books, endless notes, several teachers, or numerous topper copies to prepare effectively for UPSC. What matters is choosing the right sources, understanding the concepts clearly, and revising them repeatedly.

In this Short, Sugandha Gupta shares why fewer sources and consistent revision can be more effective than trying to read everything. Instead of collecting more study material, focus on what you can understand, retain, and apply in the UPSC Prelims and Mains.

If you’re starting your UPSC preparation, remember: Choose wisely. Understand thoroughly. Revise consistently.

#upsc  #upscbeginners  #upscpreparation  #upscstrategy  #SugandhaGupta #AIR207 #upsc2028  #upscprelims  #upscmains  #levelupias  #shorts
